title: IoT Device Cybersecurity Guidance for the Federal Government
guidance: Establishes mandatory baseline requirements for IoT asset integration: Device identification (MAC/IP cryptographic binding), network interface configuration restriction, secure logical boundary isolation (VLAN zoning), and continuous anomalous telemetry auditing.

title: OWASP Internet of Things Security Project
guidance: Identifies the highest-risk attack surfaces in IoT ecosystems: I1: Weak, Guessable, or Hardcoded Passwords; I2: Insecure Network Services (unneeded open ports, exposed Telnet/UPnP daemons); I3: Insecure Ecosystem Interfaces (unauthenticated APIs, command injection vulnerabilities); I7: Insecure Data Transfer (lack of TLS/encryption).

title: Baseline Security Recommendations for IoT in Critical Information Infrastructures
guidance: Recommends zero-trust network microsegmentation for IoT nodes, ingress filtering against spoofed source packets, automated detection of denial-of-service amplification, and immediate revocation of compromised device certificates.
